$$
[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 3\end{aligned}]

$$

$$

$$
\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 3 \\ 0 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}
$$

$$
[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 5\end{aligned}]
$$
